Attune 0.0.4 refines library browsing and navigation.

- Smooth book sizing from 50% to 160%, with evenly spaced gallery columns and a remembered size preference.
- Covers retain their proportions without grey surrounds in the gallery or book details.
- Modern sorting and filter menus match light and dark themes, support keyboard navigation, and align with their selectors.
- The library count appears in the title bar; Recently added has a simpler toolbar.
- The update icon matches the other sidebar icons with a clearer stroke.

Packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows x64, and Linux x64. USB reader support remains experimental; physical-device behavior has not been validated on every platform. macOS downloads are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. See INSTALL.txt for installation requirements and signing details.
